content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the changes introduced in SOLR-5762 that modified the expected data structure of the "docsMap" in the Javabin format for Solr requests. Previously, "docsMap" was expected to be a List of entries, but the patch adjusted it to also potentially handle cases where it is provided as a Map. This change broke backward compatibility for clients that relied on the older format of "docsMap" leading to deserialize issues when handling update requests.
